subject: ISO/FedRAMP readiness & SIG/CAIQ handoff for Acme RFP
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Price <ellen.price@acmecorp.com>; Acme Security Team <security@acmecorp.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ISO/FedRAMP readiness & SIG/CAIQ handoff for Acme RFP

Hi Ellen and Acme team —

Thanks again for the call yesterday. As discussed, Acme will be running a security diligence sprint next month as part of the RFP. You shared a SIG matrix and an updated CAIQ; I've attached the files you sent and started a mutual action plan (MAP) draft to keep owners and evidence deadlines visible.

Quick summary of the asks from your side:
- Full SIG+CAIQ response for vendor security review (spreadsheet attached)
- SOC 2 attestation copy and brief on control coverage
- ISO 27001 intent/timeline for our controls mapping (where applicable)
- FedRAMP readiness questions for any government-bound workloads

Internal ask: can the security/compliance team confirm who will take the lead on each control family and a realistic evidence delivery cadence? Acme is hoping to see the first tranche of evidence within two weeks.

Attachments: Acme_SIG_questions_v1.xlsx; Acme_CAICQ_v2.pdf

Next steps I propose:
1) Karthis (security) to provide control-owner mapping + sprint plan by 2026-09-30.
2) Redwood to deliver SOC 2 summary (redacted) and initial CAIQ answers 2026-10-05.
3) Weekly 30m syncs for the next three weeks — times in MAP.

Ellen — please tell us if the timeline above is aggressive; we can adjust but want to be transparent on dependencies (evidence owners, access to logs, etc.).

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai; Ellen Price <ellen.price@acmecorp.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ISO/FedRAMP readiness & SIG/CAIQ handoff for Acme RFP

Thanks Marissa — looping in some detail from the compliance side.

High-level plan and resource notes:
- I'll own the SIG/CAIQ response consolidation and will assign control owners by EOD 2026-09-30. Primary owners: Mina (evidence collection), Vivek (network & infra evidence), me (policies & monitoring).
- Evidence tranche 1 (policies, architecture diagrams, IAM snapshots, SOC 2 summary) -> targeted delivery 2026-10-05. Tranche 2 (log extracts, config screenshots, SAAS contracts) -> 2026-10-12.
- ISO 27001: we are not yet certified; current plan is a readiness program Q1 2027 with a gap remediation sprint in Q4 2026. For now we will provide a controls mapping indicating which implemented controls align to ISO clauses and where we have compensating measures.
- FedRAMP readiness: we have scoped a limited path (high level) for customer-isolated workloads. For Acme's RFP, please confirm whether any of their workloads will require FedRAMP-authorized endpoints. If yes, we will escalate and provide a dedicated readiness statement and expected cadence (this will add ~4 weeks).

Practical asks from Acme:
1) Which control instances require long-term logs vs. screenshots? (helps us prioritize exports)
2) Are there any required auditors/third parties that need direct access?

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_summary.pdf (redacted).

I'll populate the MAP spreadsheet with owner names and expected artifacts by EOD.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Head of Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0872

From: Ellen Price <ellen.price@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Procurement <procurement@acmecorp.com>, security@acmecorp.com
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ISO/FedRAMP readiness & SIG/CAIQ handoff for Acme RFP

Marissa / Karthik — thanks for the quick turnaround and the SOC summary. A few clarifications from our security team so we can map expectations: 

1) FedRAMP: At this stage, the RFP lists a potential MAJOR CUSTOMER that requires FedRAMP Moderate. We need to know whether Redwood can commit to a FedRAMP readiness statement for a customer-isolated deployment, and what the gating items would be. If committing to the readiness path will add 4+ weeks, we need to know now so we can flag in procurement.
2) Evidence format: Acme prefers log extracts and ephemeral snapshots where available; screenshots are acceptable only for configuration items we cannot export.
3) External auditor access: we will not require auditor access during initial review, but may request direct access to a read-only account during contract negotiations.

Two quick asks from our side:
- Can you populate the MAP with owner names and the specific artifact file names (not just categories)?
- Please confirm whether the SOC 2 summary includes AWS/third-party subservice org attachments or whether that is separate.

We appreciate the proposed cadence. If Redwood can deliver tranche 1 by 2026-10-05 that works for us.

Best,
Ellen Price
Head of Security, Acme Corp
ellen.price@acmecorp.com | +1 (212) 555-3910

Ellen — thanks for the clarity; noted on logs vs screenshots and auditor access. A couple of quick confirmations and next steps from our side:

- Karthik will add owner names + exact artifact filenames to the MAP by EOD Monday (2026-10-05). That will include a column for exportable logs vs screenshot-only artifacts.
- SOC2 attachments: the Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_summary.pdf is the customer-facing redacted summary. I will follow up with a zip of subservice org letters (AWS, GCP) and the auditor engagement letter if Acme needs them; expect that by tranche 1 delivery.
- FedRAMP readiness: Karthik — please provide a short readiness statement in the MAP indicating which gating items would extend delivery (e.g., dedicated tenancy, additional SSP work, continuous monitoring baseline). We will note the +4 weeks estimate and surface to procurement.

I've uploaded the initial MAP and a short mutual action checklist here: https://redwood.workdrive/PRJ-ACME/ma_plan and attached a copy for convenience.

Attaching: Mutual_Action_Plan_2026-10-02.xlsx

Thanks everyone — I'll schedule the first weekly 30m sync for 10/06 to walk the MAP and triage any blockers.

Cheers,
Marissa
